## Artifact
- ID:
- Current level: SPEC / SCAFFOLDED / RUNNING
- Requested level: SCAFFOLDED / RUNNING / MAINTAINED

## Required evidence
- [ ] Artifact path and commit SHA
- [ ] Exact verification command
- [ ] Full command output
- [ ] Exit code
- [ ] SHA-256 of artifact or reproducible bundle
- [ ] Owner review recorded

## Observation
What ran, where did it run, and what remains unverified?

## Safety
- [ ] No secrets included
- [ ] No deployment or computer execution implied
- [ ] CI success is not substituted for owner evidence
